prompt:
Create one standalone photorealistic photograph for Povod, a personal gift website. Use refined warm lifestyle editorial photography: considered light and composition with relaxed believable interaction, never a glossy advertising pose. Three female friends aged 27, 32, and 36 stand close together in a home living room with their arms comfortably around one another shoulders, smiling at the camera with different natural expressions. Use a lightly directed group portrait, soft bounced daylight, cream and terracotta clothing accents, and a simple believable domestic background. Output a square 1:1 composition for a website gallery. Make the key expressions and interaction readable at thumbnail size, with breathing room around the subjects. All people are fictional and independently invented for this image; do not reproduce anyone from a reference. Give them ordinary everyday appearances, distinct faces, realistic skin pores, age-appropriate texture, and natural clothing folds. Use an understated contemporary Russian or European everyday context without national stereotypes. Use warm neutrals, paper cream, muted terracotta, and natural surrounding colours with believable exposure, without a heavy orange filter. References inform only photographic techniques and mood; create an original scene and composition. Keep faces, hands, and important gestures within the central 70 percent of the frame, with comfortable safe margins and anatomically correct fingers, limbs, eyes, and teeth. No readable text, letters, numbers, logos, branding, watermarks, captions, borders, collages, grids, or contact sheets. No plastic skin, exaggerated smiles, duplicated people, extra limbs, or distorted perspective.

Distinct invented appearances for exactly three women: age 27 with copper-red shoulder-length curls and freckles; age 32 with a short ash-blond pixie, round glasses and a fuller frame; age 36 with straight dark hair in a low bun, olive skin and a tall lean frame. Do not duplicate faces or haircuts. Their embracing arms must have a clear logical connection to each body.
Composition priority: exact 1:1 aspect ratio, one complete standalone photograph with comfortable safe margins.
Use one uninterrupted coherent photograph: never dissolve any body, clothing, person or object into the background; no synthetic gradient overlays, crossfades, erased limbs or blended horizontal bands.
review: Reviewed full square image: exactly three distinct female friends pose together, a copper-curly freckled woman, an ash-blond short-haired woman with round glasses and a dark-haired woman with a low bun. The central woman's two embracing arms connect logically and both visible hands rest plausibly on shoulders. Faces are natural and different; no extra limbs or text. Square 1254x1254.
